title: Clarvis Legal invites applications for internship programme in Delhi and Ahmedabad
description: Clarvis Legal is inviting applications for its internship program in Delhi and Ahmedabad.Job DescriptionThe firm invites applications from fourth-year and final-year law students seeking practical exposure to litigation, legal research, drafting, and dispute resolution.If you are looking to learn in a dynamic litigation and advisory environment, we would love to hear from you.Location: Delhi / AhmedabadInterested candidates may send their CV/Resume via email to connect@clarvislegal.comHiring law
